**Direct answer:** Global semiconductor sales hit a record in 2024. SIA first reported $627.6 billion, up 19.1% from $526.8 billion in 2023. The same SIA page was later updated to say WSTS had revised the 2024 year-end total to $630.5 billion. It was the first year above $600 billion. The revision note doesn't give a restated growth rate, so 19.1% belongs to the original $627.6 billion figure. I'd use $630.5 billion as the current total and say which release each figure comes from.

**How to tell the kinds of number apart**
- A finalized annual figure is a realized total for a completed year. It comes from SIA/WSTS sales data and can still be revised.
- A forecast is a WSTS projection for a future year, such as the 2025 projections below. Each WSTS release replaces the one before it.
- A regional growth rate is a year-over-year change for one region. It is not the global total, and it can move the opposite way from the global figure.

**Claims and sources**

1. SIA reported 2024 global sales of $627.6 billion, up 19.1% from 2023, the highest ever.
   - https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

2. 2023 sales were $526.8 billion (the base for the 19.1%).
   - https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

3. The SIA page notes an update on March 3, 2025: WSTS revised 2024 year-end sales to $630.5 billion.
   - https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

4. Regional 2024 growth: Americas +44.8%, China +18.3%, Asia Pacific/All Other +12.5%, Japan −0.4%, Europe −8.1%. These are regional rates, not the global figure.
   - https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

5. The "double-digit growth in 2025" language in the original release is a projection, not a result.
   - https://www.semiconductors.org/global-semiconductor-sales-increase-19-1-in-2024-double-digit-growth-projected-in-2025/

6. WSTS forecasts for 2025 changed from release to release. Fall 2024 was about +11.2% (about $697 billion). Spring 2025 was +11.2% to $700.9 billion. Fall 2025 was +22.5% to $772.2 billion.
   - https://www.wsts.org/76/103/WSTS-Semiconductor-Market-Forecast-Fall-2024
   - https://www.wsts.org/esraCMS/extension/media/f/WST/7057/WSTS_FC-Release-2025_05.pdf
   - https://www.eusemiconductors.eu/sites/default/files/ESIA_WSTS_PR_AuFc2025.pdf

**Caveats**
- I read the SIA page directly (claims 1–5). The search tool's summaries supplied the WSTS forecast figures in claim 6 and the 2025 SIA Factbook's use of $630.5 billion. I didn't open the WSTS pages myself. The Factbook PDF wouldn't parse, so I couldn't confirm what it says.
- A search summary also said SIA reported $791.7 billion for 2025. I didn't verify that, so treat it as unconfirmed.
- WSTS monthly figures are three-month moving averages, per the search summary. I didn't check this in a primary source.
